rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for spectacles worn in front of the eyes.

example.english: Someone stepped on my glasses and broke them.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fu3 ngaan5 geng2 bei2 jan4 caai2 laan6 zo2

rows.note: Use this specifically for handheld binoculars rather than ordinary eyeglasses or a telescope.

example.english: We brought field glasses to watch birds in the countryside.
example.traditional: 去郊外睇雀，我哋帶咗雙筒望遠鏡。
example.jyutping: heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 tai2 zoek3 ngo5 dei6 daai3 zo2 soeng1 tung2 mong6 jyun5 geng2
